instructions: Most of this repo's source is prompt text read by agents at runtime (skills, agents, templates, references, and module help/ files). Skip subjective voice or copy-editing nits, and review against both repository correctness (broken paths, mismatched skill invocation syntax, documented behavior code does not implement, genuine factual contradictions) and the Toolsmith prompt-quality bar in AGENTS.md, tools/skill-authoring.md, skills/toolsmith/bmad-toolsmith/canon.md, and skills/toolsmith/bmad-toolsmith/lenses/standards.md (leanness, succinctness, progressive disclosure, core-vs-module boundary hygiene, and trusting the model). Where canon.md or standards.md conflicts with older step-file or module.yaml notes in tools/skill-validator.md, canon.md and standards.md win. Do not treat a concise summary that omits fallbacks documented elsewhere as a contradiction, and prefer suggesting cuts or simplifications over adding defensive edge-case qualifiers.

files.description: Repo conventions every change must satisfy
Authoring entry point and six-lens pre-PR quality bar for all skills, agents, templates, and module help/ files.
Authoritative prompt-quality canon and nine tests (leanness, core test, progressive disclosure, no over-explaining).
Authoritative skill contract (frontmatter, layout, paths, help/ files, customize.toml, bmod.toml, scripts).
Rule catalog enforced by validate_skills.py. Where older step-file or module.yaml notes conflict with canon.md or standards.md, canon.md and standards.md win.
Documentation conventions: Google style, Diataxis structure, plus project-specific rules on headers, admonitions, and nesting

rules.rule: Prompt text under skills/ (including agents, templates, references, and module help/ files) must meet tools/skill-authoring.md, canon.md, and standards.md: flag bloat, dense paragraphs, bolted-on hedging, over-explaining, broken progressive disclosure, and core-vs-module leaks (skills/core-tools/ must stay 100% module-agnostic). Note module help/ files use module-relative `help/<topic>.md` references. Prefer flagging what to cut or simplify rather than asking to enumerate corner cases.

Source changed. Check whether docs/ needs a matching update — new features, changed behavior, renamed concepts, altered CLI flags, or modified configuration options should all be reflected in the relevant doc pages. Flag missing or outdated docs.

Agent skill. The persona is configured in customize.toml under [agent]: check that every {agent.*} placeholder the SKILL.md interpolates has a corresponding key there, and that menu entries name skills that exist in this repo.
Check that internal markdown links point at files that exist.
Build and tooling script. Check error handling and that failures exit non-zero.
